subject: Invoice origin and delivery — Greenline onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@greenline.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.com
Cc: Greenline AP <ap@greenline.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T12:12:00+01:00
Subject: Invoice origin and delivery — Greenline onboarding

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this through. We're getting final sign-off from AP and need to confirm two things before we complete our vendor onboarding:

1) Who will be the invoice issuer in month 1 (Redwood vs Greenline) — we prefer Redwood to emit invoices if possible. If Redwood emits, we need the invoice to include our VAT ID (GB123456789) in the VAT field and show the PO number on line 1.

2) Delivery method: Greenline would like to adopt the portal for long-term, but we require a temporary email push (pdf copy to ap@greenline.com) for the first 60 days while our ERP mapping is completed.

Can you share a sample XML payload and the signing/ack method for electronic invoices? Also let us know if you need our VAT cert — attaching for your records.

Appreciate a short checklist we can give AP to avoid rework.

Regards,
Marta Silva
Procurement Manager — Greenline Corp
[Attachment: greenline-vat-cert.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@greenline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T13:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin and delivery — Greenline onboarding

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: Redwood can emit invoices, we can include your VAT ID and PO header, and we can do the 60-day temporary email push while portal onboarding completes. Below is the checklist and a few decisions we need you to confirm.

Invoice authority checklist (Redwood as issuer):
- Invoice issuer name: Redwood Inference Ltd (we'll include your Bill-to as Greenline Corp)
- Required fields: PO number (top-level), VAT ID (tax.vatNumber), billing contact email (ap@greenline.com)
- File formats: PDF (human) + optional UBL/UBL-like XML for AP automation
- Signature / acknowledgement: TLS-signed delivery plus an optional signed PDF (we can provide a detached signature if required)

Temporary delivery plan:
- Day 0–60: PDF emailed to ap@greenline.com with CSV/XML invoice payload attached for AP ingestion
- Day 61+: Portal becomes canonical; we will stop automatic PDF pushes unless you opt-in to copies

Open items for you to confirm:
- Do you require XML in UBL 2.1 or a custom XML schema? We attached a sample we typically send.
- Do you need an EORI or other tax field populated beyond VAT ID?
- Are there any mandated line-level tax codes we should include?

Attachments: sample invoice XML and portal onboarding quick-start.

If that looks good, can we book a 20–30 minute technical sync with your AP team (before end of week) to walk the sample and the portal claim flow? Our GTM/ops contact Kimberly will own the onboarding tasks; Ben will validate the XML schema on the gateway side.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: greenline-invoice-sample.xml (XML, 14KB)]
[Attachment: portal-push-setup.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@greenline.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T14:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin and delivery — Greenline onboarding

Marta / Avery — quick technical note from payments/ops:

- Our outbound PDF+XML push supports TLS SMTP to your mailbox and SFTP/HTTPS webhooks if you prefer an endpoint. If Greenline wants portal claim as canonical at Day 61, we'll stop push-only deliveries automatically.
- The sample XML uses our compact schema; we can emit a UBL 2.1 wrapper if your ERP requires it — confirm and we'll switch formats.
- We typically include VAT as <TaxIdentificationNumber> in the header and also echo it on each line for rate clarity when regional tax rules demand it.

If you want the detached signature route, we use RSA-SHA256 PKCS#7 for signed PDFs — Ben can share the validation keypair and verification instructions.

Ben Carter
Billing Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks Avery, Ben — this is helpful and close to what AP needs. Confirmations below: 

- Greenline accepts Redwood as the invoice issuer for the pilot (Day 0–60) provided the VAT ID is present in the header and the PO is visible on the invoice lines.
- Please emit both PDF and XML; ERP team prefers UBL 2.1 but can accept a mapping of your compact schema if you provide a field mapping document.
- We will provide EORI if required, currently VAT ID should be sufficient.
- For signature, the AP team is comfortable with TLS-signed delivery plus an attached PDF; detached PKCS#7 is optional.

Let's take the call on Thursday 10:00 CET—I'll invite our AP analyst (Jules) and give you their direct SFTP endpoint if we test webhook delivery.

Attached: verified VAT cert.

Best,
Marta
Procurement Manager — Greenline Corp
